2608.31022.title: MNIST-PRO: MNIST is Back as a Partially Observable World for AI Agents
2608.31022.paper_summary: AI agents in partially observable environments need to coordinate active sensing with working memory to maintain an evolving perceptual state. However, existing benchmarks struggle to isolate this perceptual-state construction and interpretation capability because they introduce physical and control complexities. We address this with MNIST-PRO, a benchmark that isolates agentic perception by converting MNIST digit recognition into a sequential, glimpse-based search task with lookback constraints. We evaluate ten multimodal models across four memory representations, including raw visual history, textual states, structured metric grid maps, and a consolidated visual canvas. While models excel under full observability, partial observability exposes a clear performance gap. We identify three distinct bottlenecks. First, perceptual-state construction and interpretation present a challenge, as agents struggle to integrate fragmented glimpses. Second, agents often stop exploring before they see the full sequence. Third, models often fail to revise early, incorrect beliefs even when faced with subsequent contradictory evidence. These results show that simply acquiring visual evidence is not enough. Agents must also be able to build and update a reliable perceptual state.
2608.31022.paper_summary_zh: AI 代理在部分可觀察環境中需要協調主動感知與工作記憶，以維持不斷演變的感知狀態。<lb/>然而，現有的基準測試難以孤立這種感知狀態的構建和解釋能力，因為它們引入了物理和控制的複雜性。<lb/>我們通過 MNIST-PRO 解決這個問題，這是一個通過將 MNIST 數字識別轉換為一個具有回顧約束的序列、瞬間基礎的搜索任務來孤立代理感知的基準。<lb/>我們評估了十個多模態模型，涵蓋四種記憶表示，包括原始視覺歷史、文本狀態、結構化度量網格地圖和綜合視覺畫布。<lb/>雖然模型在完全可觀察的情況下表現優異，但部分可觀察性暴露出明顯的性能差距。<lb/>我們識別出三個明確的瓶頸。<lb/>首先，感知狀態的構建和解釋是一個挑戰，因為代理難以整合碎片化的瞬間。<lb/>其次，代理經常在看到完整序列之前就停止探索。<lb/>第三，模型經常無法修正早期的錯誤信念，即使面對隨後的矛盾證據。<lb/>這些結果表明，僅僅獲取視覺證據是不夠的。<lb/>代理還必須能夠構建和更新可靠的感知狀態。
